user_story: As a librarian, I want to use artificial neural networks to analyze user behavior and improve library services, so that we can provide a better experience for our patrons.
As a social worker, I want to use neural gas to analyze and classify social work data, such as client needs and service utilization, so that I can improve social work practice and service delivery.
As a network engineer, I want to use keyword spotting to identify specific network problems and issues in network logs, so that I can better understand and troubleshoot network issues.
